-- test.glx --
places:
    test-place:
        name: Test Place
        properties:
            population:
            -   value: 110
                date: "1910"
            -   value: 220
                date: "1920"

assertions:
    assertion-existential:
        subject:
            place: test-place
        sources:
        -   test-place-almanac
    assertion-population-1920:
        subject:
            place: test-place
        property: population
        date: "1920"
        value: 220
        sources:
        -   test-place-almanac
    assertion-population-undated:
        subject:
            place: test-place
        property: population
        value: 110
        sources:
        -   test-place-almanac

sources:
    test-place-almanac:
        title: Test Place Almanac

-- want-errors --

-- want-catalog.yaml --
places:
    test-place:
        # Existential assertion attached to entity
        assertions:
        -   assertions/assertion-existential
        name: Test Place
        properties:
            population:
                definition:
                    label: Population
                    value_type: integer
                entries:
                -   date: "1910"
                    value: IntValue{110}
                -   date: "1920"
                    value: IntValue{220}
                    # Dated assertion attached to dated entry
                    assertions:
                    -   assertions/assertion-population-1920
                # Undated assertion attached to property
                assertions:
                -   assertions/assertion-population-undated

assertions:
    assertion-existential:
        subject: places/test-place
        sources:
        -   sources/test-place-almanac
    assertion-population-1920:
        subject: places/test-place
        property: population
        value: "220"
        date: "1920"
        sources:
        -   sources/test-place-almanac
    assertion-population-undated:
        subject: places/test-place
        property: population
        value: "110"
        sources:
        -   sources/test-place-almanac

sources:
    test-place-almanac:
        title: Test Place Almanac
